    Life at Slikk
    Our Story

    THIS IS OUR (LOVE) STORY

    Our story began with creating TikTok moves purely for fun. As our videos went viral, we continued to innovate, eventually realizing the potential to partner with major brands and introduce them to TikTok’s vibrant ecosystem.

    By leveraging our passion and expertise in creating engaging content, we transitioned into producing high-impact video marketing campaigns. Today, we affiliate with leading consumer brands to generate viral campaigns, achieving millions of views on TikTok and Instagram Reels.

    Our distribution network spans Facebook ads, TikTok ads, Google Adsense, SEO, content websites, and mobile performance platforms via Taboola, Outbrain, programmatic advertising, and retargeting campaigns.

    Utilizing Real Time Trend Discovery technology, we ensure that our content remains aligned with the latest trends, seamlessly integrating our affiliate brands into the most current and engaging narratives.
